query:
INSERT INTO mlc_cases
         (tenant_id, er_visit_id, patient_id, mlc_number, case_type,
          history_of_incident, registered_by)
         SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM mlc_cases WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND er_visit_id = $2
         )
